title: RiffSync catalog bundle
description: Shape of canonical catalog rows (future DB/API). Repo JSON is seed/fixture—not production truth.

version.description: Bump when the bundle shape changes incompatibly.

$schema.description: Editor hint pointing at this schema file.

updated.description: Last curated update (YYYY-MM-DD), or null until first publish.

id.description: Stable URL-safe slug (1+ chars): lowercase letters, digits, hyphen. Never recycle for another experiment.

experimentNumber.description: Classic experiment number where it applies; null for specials or non-numbered clips.

title.description: Display title shown in catalog and room previews.

anyOf.description: Set when TMDB/grid metadata exists but an embed-ready upload is still unmapped.
Official YouTube 11-character video id for IFrame embedding.

youtubeVideoId.description: Official YouTube id for embedding when known; otherwise null until curated.

youtubeWatchUrl.description: Canonical watch URL (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=…) when verifying or linking without an id yet.

era.description: Hosting era labeling for UX filters.

embedAllows.description: If false, the app should hide or warn (video may not play in iframe). True when manually verified; null unknown.

curatorNotes.description: Internal note (e.g. alternate uploads, region caveats). Not shown in-app unless you choose to.

movieSearchTitle.description: Override string for TMDB search when riff episode title differs from the underlying film title.

tmdbMovieId.description: Lock to a TMDB movie id after manual verify (skips ambiguous search).

tmdbPosterPath.description: Raw poster_path from the resolved movie (TMDB); reconcile composes posterImageUrl.

tmdbBackdropPath.description: Raw backdrop_path from the resolved movie (TMDB wide still); reconcile composes backdropImageUrl.

posterImageUrl.description: Resolved CDN URL for card/grid layouts (from poster_path; not cast photos).

backdropImageUrl.description: Resolved CDN URL from movie backdrop_path (hero / blurred chrome). Not logos or actor imagery.

tmdbArtworkSyncedAt.description: UTC timestamp when scheduled reconciliation last refreshed TMDB poster and backdrop paths/URLs.
